reserveReview.rationale: The May 29, 2026 BPM examination reports the reserve holdings as cash deposits at State Street and Western Alliance Bank. A separate net cash payable from timing and settlement differences reconciles the gross deposits to circulating GUSD and is not treated as a reserve asset slice.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The examination discloses the complete reserve asset class and names both banks, but does not disclose the allocation between them.
